subject: Offer authorization: Lead Inference Engineer — StackLytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-interview summary & recommended comp range for Hector Alvarez

Team — quick debrief on Hector (final loop completed yesterday). Strong technical leadership on model infra (led a multi-region rollout at StackLytics), excellent system design answers, and solid cross-functional examples for shipping inference at scale. Two interviewers flagged his product judgment as above IC4 expectations.

Recommendation (hiring manager): Level: IC4 -> propose IC5 stretch. Comp: base $200,000 with 15% target bonus and 0.25% RSU refresh cadence; sign-on $15,000. Total comp roughly in the $235k–255k first-year range.

Attachments: Interview_Summary_StackLytics_HectorAlvarez.pdf (detailed feedback), comp_benchmark_Q4_2026.xlsx

Ask: Can we get an exception/level uplift approval? If yes, I will route the draft offer to Legal and coordinate a verbal with the candidate tomorrow afternoon.

—Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-interview summary & recommended comp range for Hector Alvarez

Marissa — thanks for the write-up and the interview packet. I agree the candidate is above bar for the role. A couple of notes:

- IC5 is reasonable given he led hiring and infra ownership at his prior employer; we should capture a 6-month milestone tied to scale/latency improvements.
- I'm supportive of the $200k base but recommend widening the band to $195k–215k to give negotiating flexibility.
- Can we justify the RSU/refresh at 0.25% against current banding? Please include market comps (you attached the benchmark, which is helpful).

If folks are aligned, I can approve a one-time leveling exception for this hire (exec discretion) pending Finance sign-off on the RSU refresh cadence.

—Aditya

Subject: Re: Post-interview summary & recommended comp range for Hector Alvarez

Thanks — flagged a couple of Finance and People items I need before I can greenlight the exception:

1) Please confirm headcount and hiring authority (is this replacing an open seat or a net-new headcount?)
2) Provide a brief manager justification focusing on business impact and expected deliverables for the first 6 months (single paragraph is fine).
3) Confirm the comp band the candidate would sit in post-acceptance for comp planning (we need to avoid creating compression issues).

Once I have those, I'll run it with comp committee. If Finance is tight on RSU pool this quarter we'll consider a higher cash component instead.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-interview summary & recommended comp range for Hector Alvarez

All — quick update after reviewing the benchmark and headcount. This is a replacement for the open Lead Inference role (headcount already approved in Q3). Manager justification (for the committee):

"Hector will own model serving reliability and lead the inference runtime roadmap to reduce tail latency by 20% and enable multi-region failover. Deliverables: ship KV cache eviction policy, finalize quantization rollout plan, and lead a post-launch perf retro within 6 months."

Finance note: we have flexibility to stretch the base to the top of band for strategic hires this quarter. I'm comfortable approving the IC5 leveling exception and the $195k–215k base band with 15% bonus; RSU refresh to be discussed with Payroll/Comp. Conditions: 6-month checkpoint and documented performance milestones.

Please prep the Draft_Offer_StackLytics_HectorAlvarez.docx and loop Legal for a quick review (cc: contracts@stacklytics.com in the external flow).

On Mon, Nov 02, 2026 at 08:34 AM Lauren Bishop wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hector Alvarez <hector@stacklytics.com>, Megan Liu <megan@talenthunt.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, contracts@stacklytics.com
Date: 2026-11-03T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Offer next steps and proposed timeline

Hector / Megan — thanks again for your time. Following internal approvals, we are authorized to extend an offer subject to final legal review. Proposed verbal: tomorrow (Wed) at 3:30pm PT.

Key terms we plan to present verbally:
- Title: Lead Inference Engineer (IC5, leveling exception)
- Base: $200,000 (flexible within $195k–215k)
- Bonus: 15% target
- RSU: 0.25% target refresh cadence (pending comp confirmation)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)
- Conditions: standard Redwood background check; 6-month performance checkpoint with milestones

Attachments: Draft_Offer_StackLytics_HectorAlvarez.docx (draft), Interview_Summary_StackLytics_HectorAlvarez.pdf

If the time works I will call you at the number on file. If legal needs changes to language, contracts@stacklytics.com — please reply with redlines and we'll incorporate.
